CHAPTER 2 · ITEM 12 / 12

Graphs and evidence

Correlation & causation相關與因果

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Explain why correlation alone does not establish causation; recognize omitted variables and reverse causality in examples.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

相關可能來自因果、共同遺漏因素或反向因果。單看圖形通常無法分辨；要問是否漏了因素，或因果方向倒轉。

A correlation can reflect a causal effect, an omitted common cause or reverse causality. A graph alone generally cannot distinguish these explanations. Ask what variable is missing and which direction of influence is plausible.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：Cities with more crime hire more police. A positive police–crime correlation need not mean police cause crime. 高犯罪可引致增聘警察。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

More lighters correlate with cancer; smoking is unmeasured. Main concern? 打火機與癌症相關但未量度吸煙？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
